subject: Stark Commerce: outage impact & remediation request
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@starkcommerce.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Impact during Oct 29 incident — credit request

Hi Irene,

Quick note from Stark Commerce — we experienced significant degradation of the Redwood inference endpoint for our customer-facing checkout assistant on Oct 29 between 11:05–14:15 PDT. During that window our checkout conversion dropped and we triggered manual fallbacks; we estimate ~3 hours of degraded service.

Could you confirm whether this incident is covered under your SLA and what remediation options you can offer? Our procurement and product teams are asking for a goodwill credit and an extension of our evaluation trial while we validate resiliency.

I can share logs and a screenshot (attached). Please escalate to the team that handles credit/remedy packages — this is time-sensitive for our renewal discussion next week.

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Doe
Director of Product
Stark Commerce

Attachments: stark-uptime-screenshot.png (PNG)
From: irene.choi@redwood.ai
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@starkcommerce.com>
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:43:15 -07:00
Subject: Re: Impact during Oct 29 incident — credit request

Jane — thanks for the heads up and the screenshot. Really sorry about the disruption; I appreciate the clear timing window. I've looped in Sean (account lead) and Neha (support/ops) to gather the SLO export and a recommended remediation package.

Two quick asks while we pull evidence:
- Can you confirm the internal transaction ids/paths that hit the assistant during that window? A small manifest helps map requests to our logs.
- Do you want a simple credit + trial extension, or would a one-time discount for Q1 also be helpful for your renewal?

We’ll come back with a remedy proposal and the SLO export by end of day Monday.

Irene Choi
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:07:22 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Impact during Oct 29 incident — credit request (proposal draft)

Irene / Neha — based on the SLO export (attached) and the customer impact described, here is a draft remedy package for Stark Commerce: 

Proposal (draft):
- One-time account credit: 75,000 token credit (applied to account balance)
- Trial/top-up: 45-day trial extension for the evaluation team (extends current dev environment access)
- Commercial goodwill: 10% off Redwood usage for Q1 next year (must be set up in finance)

Rationale: customer saw sustained degradation during peak hours; token credit covers remediation work and token churn from replays; extension buys us time to validate fixes and keep them on the platform for renewal.

Questions for Markus: do we need CSM signoff or exec approval for the 75k + 10%? If so, recommend final approval and a finance action to apply a one-time credit and an amendment for the trial extension.

Attachments: slo-window-export.csv
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:18:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Impact during Oct 29 incident — credit request (proposal draft)

Sounds reasonable. Approve the modified package with one change: increase the one-time token credit to 100,000 and include the 45-day trial extension. Approve the 10% Q1 discount as optional — coordinate with Finance for proper booking so it doesn't commit long-term pricing changes.

Action items:
- Finance (Neha): create a goodwill credit entry referencing deal DC-5921 and prepare amendment draft (redwood-remedy-amendment-draft.pdf).
- SE (Irene/Sean): send formal offer to Jane and procurement with attachments and next steps (DocuSign link for the amendment).

Markus Klein
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: irene.choi@redwood.ai
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@starkcommerce.com>, procurement@starkcommerce.com
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2026 14:33:10 -07:00
Subject: Redwood remedy package for Oct 29 impact — DC-5921

Hi Jane / Stark procurement — following internal review, thank you again for the incident details. Attached is the formal remedy package we propose. Summary below: 

Remedy package for Oct 29 incident (DC-5921):
- One-time credit: 100,000 token credit applied to Stark Commerce account (shows as goodwill credit on next invoice)
- Trial extension: 45-day evaluation extension for the dev/test environment starting on sign date
- Optional commercial: Offer of 10% off usage for Q1 2027 (requires separate approval and PO; not applied automatically)

Attachments included: redwood-remedy-amendment-draft.pdf, slo-window-export.csv (evidence), stark-uptime-screenshot.png.

Next steps:
1) If this looks good, countersign the amendment (DocuSign link below) or reply to this thread with approval; procurement can also confirm PO details to have the credit applied.
2) Neha will create the goodwill credit entry in our billing system once we receive confirmation and will post the credit against invoice sequence ID referenced in DC-5921.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/REDWOOD-DC-5921-amend

Appreciate your partnership and apologies again for the disruption — we’re also running a post-incident kernel-level patch in staging to reduce recurrence.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
